root_cause: The Escape key handler in the list controller unconditionally clears the input value, causing the typed city to be lost when dismissing suggestions.
repair_strategy: Remove the line that sets ctx.input.value = '' in the Escape case of the navigate function in src/controllers/listController.js, keeping the close and clear event emission.
expected_accessibility_effect: Escape will close the suggestion list without clearing the input, preserving user input and maintaining keyboard operability per WCAG 2.1.1 and 2.4.3.
functional_risks: Any code that relies on the input being cleared after Escape may behave differently; however the clear event is still emitted.
verification_requirements: After typing a city and pressing Escape, the suggestion list must be hidden, focus must return to the input, and the input value must remain as typed.
Pressing Escape when the suggestion list is already open must close it without altering the input value.
Pressing Escape when no suggestions are present must not cause errors.
